blurb: Skyway Aviation operates as an FAA Part 135 certificated air carrier specializing in private jet charters with a narrow fleet of aircraft for regional and time-critical missions. They provide operational depth and regional reach exclusively through aviation brokers, offering free AOG coverage to protect broker margins. Their fleet includes Citation CJ3, Citation XLS, and Learjet 60 aircraft, each with specific cabin sizes and performance characteristics.
